policy.officialCardVerified: Exact card artwork/product page is confirmed on an issuer-controlled official domain.
policy.bankBrandingVerified: Issuer identity and brand palette are confirmed, but exact card artwork is not.
policy.reviewRequired: A previously checked official source changed; human review is required before promoting verification.
policy.unverified: No authoritative source has been checked. Never present generated artwork as official.
policy.note: Network directories identify issuers/products; they do not prove the issuer's exact card artwork.

importContract.verification: Only HTTPS official issuer/regulator/network source URLs are eligible. Source changes are flagged for review; automation never upgrades an unverified record to verified.
